local function read_first_line(path)
    local file = io.open(path, "r")
    if not file then return nil, "unable to open input file" end
    local ok, line = pcall(function() return file:read("*l") end)
    local close_ok = file:close()
    if not ok then return nil, "read failed" end
    if close_ok == nil then return nil, "close failed" end
    return line
end
local line, err = read_first_line("notes.txt")
if line then print(line) else print(err) end
